title: Trio Petroleum Corp 8-K Filing — ATM Equity Distribution Updates
summary: Trio Petroleum Corp filed an 8-K on April 7, 2026, updating investors on the status of its At Market Issuance (ATM) equity distribution agreement with Ladenburg Thalmann & Co.
